name: Cornélio Procópio (Brazil)
description: Dark blue field with a white central rectangle bearing the municipal arms, from which eight stripes of white, yellow and black radiate to the edges.
history: Cornélio Procópio is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. Flags of the World reports a source giving the flag as approved by Law No. 469 of 2 December 1948, but doubts the date, since the design appears to be the work of the heraldist Arcinóe Antônio Peixoto de Faria, active in the 1970s and 1980s; the arms were approved by Law No. 53 of 28 October 1948. The arms stand for the municipal government and the radiating stripes for the spread of its power over the territory.
